title: Berry Farming Guide
subject: Where every berry comes from — odds from the game's own tables — per hour on auto-replay

board.title: Berry Farming Guide — per hour on auto-replay

method.summary: Expected values from the game's own drop tables, not measured runs. Lap times come from the farming guide's simulation (best endgame team, every lap won). Town events are counted once per lap and at most 6 an hour; Battle Points and pachinko balls are not counted per hour. Badges unlock better berries: route ? and town events only drop a berry once the region has enough gym badges before that chapter — Golden Razz and Pecha 3, Nanab, Enigma and Sitrus 6, Starf and Belue 8. Belue and Rowap never drop on routes: town events, the shop and pachinko only. The shop sells common berries at 40 BP, Starf at 250 BP on floor 75+, Belue at 250 BP on floor 87+, always in stock. Pachinko gives about 2.5% of cup prizes as berries, one prize per ball in the cup. Underground loot rolls start at floor 150 and get better deeper.

algorithm.goal: Rank loops by expected good berries per hour and list each berry's best sources.
algorithm.engine: The game's own drop tables at build d8622a1fb3; lap times from the farming guide's simulation
steps: Take each berry's drop chance from the game's route, town-event, shop, pachinko and Underground tables.
Apply the badge gates before a chapter: Golden Razz/Pecha 3 region badges, Nanab/Enigma/Sitrus 6, Starf/Belue 8.
Count town events once per lap, capped at 6 an hour.
Use the farming guide's lap time for each loop (best endgame team, every lap won).
Multiply expected drops per lap by laps per hour; report good berries/h, Starf/h and Oran-and-friends/h.
Ignore Battle Points and pachinko balls in the per-hour totals.

gameFacts: Routes: 70% chance per item route, once per run, with 8+ region badges.
Town events: once per run, at most 6 an hour, 8+ region badges.
Shop: common berries 40 BP, Starf 250 BP at floor 75+, Belue 250 BP at floor 87+, always in stock.
Pachinko: about 2.5% of cup prizes, one prize per ball in the cup.
Underground: loot rolls at floor 150+, deeper is better.
Belue and Rowap never drop on routes.
Badge gates: Golden Razz & Pecha 3 region badges, Nanab/Enigma & Sitrus 6, Starf & Belue 8.

uncertain: The Lansat/Pinap card's best loop is cut off in the OCR (the loop name is missing); the rate (8.1/h each) and lap time (54s) are legible, so the loop is stored as '?' rather than guessed.

Several route and town-event percentages are OCR-damaged: Pecha 8.4% (read '84%'), Razz 8.3%, Sitrus 3.1%, Starf 1% and the Belue/Starf/Sitrus tail of the table. The clear rows are stored; the damaged tail rows were left out instead of invented.
